maria: quick sync — brought up the new hf/gpt-like checkpoint on staging and hit a JSON-emit regression when using our tool-invoke shim.
ajay: repro steps?
maria: load tokenizer from HF, apply our conversion script, then sample with json-mode tokens. sometimes the model emits an extra <|tool_end|> before the json blob.
tim: saw that in quantized runs too? 4-bit vs fp16?
maria: yes. repro with both 4-bit PTQ and FP16. 4-bit more likely.
sophie: can you paste the exact conversion snippet you used?
maria: sure:
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
Tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('hf-org/new-model')
Tok.add_special_tokens({'additional_special_tokens': ['<|json_start|>','<|json_end|>','<|tool_call|>','<|tool_end|>']})
Tok.save_pretrained('./converted')
# our converter also inserts a config.json mapping: 'role_tokens': {'tool': '<|tool_call|>'} 
```
ajay: two quick suspects: (1) tokenizer special_tokens_map mismatch (HF vs RW names) (2) our role-token sentinel insertion logic accidentally adds a trailing tool_end before the assistant-generated json when kv-cache is flushed.
tim: related: during 4-bit quant runs we observed attention-kernel padding changes that shift token alignment by 1 in some decoding loops. that can manifest as extra token emission.
benchbot: evaluation summary (staging, 50 prompts):
- fp16 baseline: json-valid 96/50 (typo: 96% valid)
- 4-bit PTQ: json-valid 82/50 (82% valid)
- 4-bit + sentinel-fix (local patch): json-valid 91/50
(reported with strict JSON parse)
maria: the local patch Ajay mentioned?
ajay: pushed a small guard: only emit <|tool_end|> when current role == 'tool' and not immediately before '<|json_start|>'. naive but reduced false-positives.
sophie: i ran a token-level diff between HF tokenizer and our converted vocab. noticed we had duplicated byte-pair for '<|json_start|>' mapping to two ids (one canonical, one alias). that explains some parity issues.
maria: ugh — dupe mapping can cause the decoder to pick the alias before our check. fix: collapse aliases during conversion.
tim: also a longer-term fix: use reserved single-byte sentinel tokens instead of multi-token strings for json markers, so they survive quantized embedding noise. e.g. use 0xFF4 token ids we reserve in model config. need HF checkpoint rewrite though.
sophie: config.json we generate currently includes: 
```json
{"special_tokens": {"json_start": "<|json_start|>", "json_end": "<|json_end|>", "tool_call": "<|tool_call|>", "tool_end": "<|tool_end|>"}, "role_tokens": {"assistant": "", "tool": "<|tool_call|>"}}
```
but HF configs sometimes put `additional_special_tokens` under tokenizer.json instead. conversion needs to merge both.
benchbot: quick note: benchmarks show ~1.3% throughput drop when using extra single-token sentinels (embedding lookup overhead), but json-valid improves by ~9%. tradeoff logged.
ajay: action items: (1) conversion script: dedupe special token aliases and merge tokenizer.json/additional_special_tokens (maria) (2) runtime: tighten `emit_tool_end` guard and add kv-cache sanity check (tim) (3) eval: rerun 1k prompt bench in 4-bit with alias collapse + sentinel-as-single-token (sophie + benchbot).
maria: putting a PR up for conversion script now. patch branch: fix/special-token-collapse.
sophie: one more caveat — if chat-template inserts role token before BOS (we do this for compatibility), some HF tokenizers treat leading role tokens as whitespace-trim triggers and strip them. need to standardize chat templates to insert role tokens after BOS.
tim: good call. that could explain role-anchor shift during decoding.
ajay: for logging, please add a tiny metric: token-id sequence around json_start (prev3, next3) for failures. will help root-cause.
maria: logging added. sample failure: prev tokens ids [50256, 10, 431] then alias id 99999 emitted instead of canonical 40001.
sophie: weird id 99999 — that's our placeholder alias id from old converter. must fully remove those placeholders.
benchbot: scheduling rerun: 2024-09-12T14:30Z (jobs queued).
maria: thx all. I'll post results thread here after bench. feel free to @ajay if you see infra errors. :thumbsup:
ajay: cool, merged guard to staging; watching. :eyes:
tim: will run attention alignment test after bench results.
